LavenderPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
To the north of
LAVENDER is ROCK

TUNNEL. Go through
it to get to the POWER PLANT.
LavenderPokecenter1FTeacherText:
There's a radio
program that plays # FLUTE music.

Oh? Ah, your radio
needs an EXPN CARD to tune into it.
LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
If the POWER PLANT
isn't running, the

MAGNET TRAIN won't
run either…

It also means the
RADIO STATION can't broadcast…
LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText_Return:
The DIRECTOR of
the RADIO STATION sure was happy.

He said they're
back on the air

because the POWER
PLANT is running smoothly again.
